name: design-studio
description: A design studio in a skill. A Head of Studio runs a team of designer agents (visual, type, content, interaction, product, brand & marketing, emotion) who design together and critique each other's work in rounds.

interface.shortDescription: Designer agents that make and critique UI together
interface.longDescription: A Head of Studio facilitates a visual designer, typographer, content strategist, interaction designer, product strategist, brand & marketing designer and emotion designer. They study your references, explore directions as quick prototypes, build a system and screens, critique each other's work from screenshots, and polish until it clears a studio-grade bar.
defaultPrompt: Use $design-studio:studio to design a pricing page for my app
